subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and replay media from unmentioned requireMention group messages for later mentioned turns, and what bounded privacy/retention policy should govern it?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but fixing it changes what group bystander attachments can be retained and exposed to a later model prompt, while current code deliberately skips unmentioned group media before download.

options.title: Approve bounded image retention
options.body: Record only bounded local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages under existing group authorization and context-visibility rules, then prove it with source tests and live Telegram evidence.

options.title: Keep unmentioned media text-only
options.body: Treat unmentioned Telegram group media as intentionally unavailable to later turns and document that group history may preserve only text/placeholders in this case.

options.title: Require live design proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open until a maintainer-reviewed live Telegram probe demonstrates the current failure and the proposed retention behavior with privacy limits.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded image retention
recommendation.body: Record only bounded local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages under existing group authorization and context-visibility rules, then prove it with source tests and live Telegram evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Telegram group-history and context-selection work makes this the closest owner signal for the channel policy boundary.
